scheme_name: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies (UGC)
authority: University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
benefit: ₹15,000 per month for 10 months each year for 2 years (total ₹3,00,000 tenure)

criteria.label: Enrolled in 1st year of regular Post-Graduate program
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be admitted into 1st year of regular Master degree program in a recognized university or institute.

criteria.label: Age limit (<= 30 years at admission)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate age must not exceed 30 years as of the academic year admission cutoff.
criteria.source_clause: UGC PG Guidelines Clause 3.2 - Age Ceiling
criteria.remediation: Candidate must be 30 years of age or younger.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account ready
criteria.plain_description: Aadhaar must be linked to active bank account for DBT fellowship payment.

application.office_name: University Grants Commission (UGC) / University Nodal Officer
documents_to_carry: Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Proof
process_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal via OTR
Apply under UGC Section: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies
Submit academic marks from undergraduate degree
Monthly DBT fellowship credit into bank account
